summary: validate-modules codes multiple-csharp-utils-per-requires, no-default-for-required-parameter, no-log-needed (set no_log=False for false positives), nonexistent-parameter-documented, option-incorrect-version-added, option-invalid-version-added, parameter-invalid, parameter-invalid-elements and implied-parameter-type-mismatch.
questions: How do I fix the no-log-needed sanity error?

answer_card.title: Fix no-log-needed
answer_card.answer_md: `no-log-needed` fires when an option name suggests a secret but the argument spec does not set `no_log`. Set `no_log=True` for real secrets. If it is a false positive, set `no_log=False` explicitly on that option in the argument spec.
